summary: Planned the books extension wiring as 8 phases across 5 waves (10.5h estimate). Fixed design from the research report's Decisions: two routing blocks only (routing_agents, routing_agents_hard) keyed on books and books:certify (books:document deliberately omitted); four model:sonnet agents including --hard variants; six skills (4 lifecycle + 2 direct-execution); /book and /certify as separate commands; a books rule using the flattened book-directory layout. The plan adds one measured decision research left open: check-extension-docs.sh Rule E hard-fails on any bare *.sh token in commands/skills/agents/README/EXTENSION that is not in some provides.scripts, so the plan ships exactly one declared passthrough wrapper (books-certify.sh) plus its fixture test, which also makes the dispatch's deliverable-7 test requirement real. Also resolved: provides.context needs an on-disk navigation stub at context/project/books/README.md because the domain corpus is a separate dependent task. Four follow-ups recorded to spawn, not absorbed.
